method: Explicit kit/real-ruins/prior north+south analysis fixtures in isolated DEV lab. Actual touch or gamepad choice interactions and movement against the real probe collider. No sounding/archive/boss victory fixture.
checks: warrior: real touch rejects loose bed, accepts firm bed and moves into the sampler collision without crossing
hunter: real touch rejects loose bed, accepts firm bed and moves into the sampler collision without crossing
astral: real touch rejects loose bed, accepts firm bed and moves into the sampler collision without crossing
xenobinder: real touch rejects loose bed, accepts firm bed and moves into the sampler collision without crossing
Standard gamepad A/left stick validates both beds and physical collision; layouts inspected at 568x320, 844x390, 1024x768 and 1920x1080
